description: Bring a deleted wiki page back from its space's trash, with every page that went with it: under its old parent, or at the top of the space when that parent is gone. 'id' is the page's id — the one delete_wiki_page answered, or from list_wiki_trash; a page that went with its parent comes back with the whole set. Refused while another page of the space has taken one of its titles. Only the project's administrators may restore.
name: restore_wiki_page
title: Restore wiki page
